local_checks.invariant: evaluatePolicyGates overallStatus determination should not give REVIEW when 4 of 5 policy gates pass without dominancePassed being the sole failing gate
local_checks.result: The evaluatePolicyGates function in gates.ts determines overall status as PASS only if passedCount >= 4 AND dominancePassed is true. If 4 out of 5 individual policy gates pass but COST_DOMINANCE fails, the overall status is REVIEW, which may mislead stakeholders about the optimization quality. This creates a disconnect where an optimization meeting all other criteria (mass conservation, budget compliance, ICU collapse mitigation, hub coverage) but barely failing cost dominance receives a REVIEW rating instead of PASS.

attempts.reassignment_reason: Post-wave critic reassigned the unit after the first-wave owner closed it as a candidate: evaluatePolicyGates in packages/engine/src/gates.ts assigns REVIEW when exactly four of five gates pass and cost dominance fails, and the first-wave evidence did not establish the documented intended status or any affected principal.

local_checks.invariant: evaluatePolicyGates enforces 5 gates: MASS_CONSERVATION (<1e-9 & zero NaN), BUDGET_COMPLIANCE (maxWeeklyAssigned <= weeklyQuotaK), COST_DOMINANCE (J(SennaGrid) < J(Reactive)), ICU_COLLAPSE_MITIGATION (>=40% reduction or 0 days), HUB_COVERAGE (>=50% in Weeks 1-4)
computeHubCoverage ranks hubCentrality, takes top quartile, checks early-week (w<4) schedule treatment, returns hubCoverageRatio >= 0.5 for pass

optimizeResourceAllocation flows: buildMobilityModel -> createSolverContext -> createInitialState -> buildReactiveSchedule/simulateFullSchedule -> swap-based Stage 2 improvement with ICU-first and cost-dominance guardrails

PolicyGateSummary overallStatus is 'PASS' | 'REVIEW' | 'FAIL' with readinessScore 0..100; gates each have id/label/passed/observed/threshold; all fields source-verified in gates.ts evaluatePolicyGates
